title: Inductive-limit bounded Lipschitz cylinder form contract
question: Do finite-support bounded C1 cylinder multipliers define a volume-compatible inductive-limit test algebra with the same two-orientation Q3 form bounds, while leaving dynamics convergence as a separate gate?
method: Use the EXP-001131 shifted Q3 form order K_edge <= 21 K_on for the bounded-degree-six graph class.
For every declared support size S and every ambient volume V >= S, compute the exact same-form and cross-form weighted product constants from M=1 and L=1; verify that they depend on S but not on V.
Check restriction/extension compatibility for all ambient-volume pairs containing the same support, so the multiplier is unchanged on S and identity outside S.
Apply the bounded C1 product rule to two fixed-support factors (M1,L1)=(1,1) and (M2,L2)=(2,3/2), obtaining M12=2, L12=7/2, same-form bound 81/4 and cross-form bound 1701/4.
Rebuild the arithmetic in an independent Fraction-only lane and compile Lean R320 for the degree, product, embedding and scope fixtures.
finding: Primary 92/92, independent 61/61, integrated 15/15, and Lean R320 compile PASS. For support size S the same-form squared bound is 2+S and the cross-orientation bound is 21(2+S), with the same exact values in every ambient volume V in {S,...,16}. All restriction/extension pairs preserve these constants. The product fixture gives M12=2, L12=7/2, same-form 81/4 and cross-form 1701/4.
decision_reason: The bounded finite-support C1 cylinder class now has an explicit inductive-limit compatibility contract at the form level: ambient-volume embeddings do not change its local constants, and products remain in the same class with a computable Leibniz bound. This supplies the appropriate bounded QFT test-algebra interface, but it does not make finite-volume dynamics converge or identify an infinite-volume state or alpha_t.
closed: same- and cross-orientation weighted square-root form bounds
independent reproduction and Lean R320 cross-check
open: all bounded local observables without an explicit gradient bound
unbounded polynomial products and exact CCR domains
direct D and delta-D Cauchy estimates
finite-volume dynamics convergence and exhaustion-independent states
broken-sector gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A

adversarial_review.check: Only the declared finite support is active under an ambient embedding; no volume-dependent gradient term is added outside the support.
Same and cross form orientations remain separate and the exact factor 21 is retained.
The gradient is bounded by M1 L2 + M2 L1, while no unbounded polynomial is admitted.
Uniformity is only in ambient volume at fixed support; constants can grow with support size.
Algebraic/form compatibility is not confused with convergence of dynamics or states.
R320 proves rational bookkeeping only and contains no axioms, sorry, unbounded operator theorem or limit.
Direct Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: A fixed-support bounded C1 cylinder test algebra contract compatible with bounded-degree graph embeddings and explicit same/cross form constants independent of ambient volume.
qft_interface.open: Unbounded products, exact CCR domains, cutoff/beta modular transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, finite-volume dynamics convergence, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

next_action: Use this bounded inductive-limit test algebra to formulate and test a finite-volume D/delta-D Cauchy estimate; require an explicit source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform bound before promoting a common alpha or OS/KMS/GNS limit.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing inductive-limit test-algebra contract. It is a bounded form/algebra interface only and does not establish a thermodynamic QFT dynamics, a common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
no_overclaim: Only the declared fixed-support bounded C1 cylinder compatibility and form constants are closed. All unbounded, modular, dynamics-limit, reconstruction, gap, continuum and production gates remain open.
